name: xAI MACROHARDRR data center (Southaven)
summary: Third xAI data center in the Memphis area, made by retrofitting a warehouse of roughly 800,000 square feet that xAI bought in late 2025 in Southaven, Mississippi, just south of Colossus 2 across the state line. Mississippi's governor announced it in January 2026 as an investment of more than $20 billion, the largest economic development project in state history, supported by a state sales and use tax exemption and local fee-in-lieu agreements. Musk said it would lift Colossus training compute to about 2 GW, and a July 2026 report relaying his comments said it holds 220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs.

location.note: Center of the OpenStreetMap building tagged 'xAI Macrohardrr' on Stateline Road West, taken from this project's OpenStreetMap data center layer (no geocoder call), about 0.5 km south of the Colossus 2 building. This matches Cleanview's address of 2400 Stateline Road, Southaven, and WREG's description of the warehouse as just south of Colossus 2.

parties.name: Mississippi Development Authority
parties.note: Approved the project for the state Data Center Incentive sales and use tax exemption.

parties.name: City of Southaven
parties.note: Supports the project through a fee-in-lieu agreement.

parties.name: DeSoto County
parties.note: Supports the project through a fee-in-lieu agreement.

metrics.note: Size of the warehouse being retrofitted; Converge Digest and Cleanview give about 810,000 square feet and WREG gives 800,000.
Elon Musk's figure as relayed by WMC in July 2026; not confirmed in a company filing. No Colossus 2 figure is repeated here.

milestones.note: Musk disclosed the purchase of an 800,000-square-foot Southaven warehouse on December 30, 2025; the governor's release says xAI bought an existing building for the project.
Target stated at the January 2026 announcement; no source reviewed confirms the actual start date.

notes: Status is inferred from a July 2026 WMC report that calls Macro-harder an existing site equipped with 220,000 GB300 GPUs, relaying Elon Musk; no source reviewed confirms when operations began. Converge Digest labels the building 'Colossus 2 (MACROHARDRR)', and analyst estimates for Colossus 2 (xai-colossus-2-memphis) may include it; no Colossus 2 figure is repeated here. The 2 GW figure in the announcements refers to xAI's combined Colossus compute, not this building alone.
